name: Shoe
material: silk (textile); gold thread; spangles; leather; paper
dimensions: Height 11 cm; Width 7 cm; Length 22 cm
summary: This striking pair of Manchu shoes would have elevated their female wearer. The thick, boat-shaped soles are made from layers of felted paper, whitened around the edges, with stitched leather bottoms. Manchu women of lower ranks used such shoes for outdoor wear. The paper sole is rigid, but upturned
